notes: Article page prints no publication date; 2025-12 inferred from third-party aggregator (theresanaiforthat.com lists 2025-12-18) and is consistent with Seed 2.0 launching 2026-02-14 - treat as month precision pending an official date. Every score panel is an image; verified rows are exactly the five prose-printed values (BrowseComp-en 67.6, WorldTravel multi-modal 47.2 best-of-5, ZeroBench main 11.0, VLMsAreBiased 62.0, VideoMME 87.8 with subtitles and VideoCut tool) plus the two prose-named qualitative rows (FinSearchComp, XpertBench). Chart footnotes: '*' = scores sourced from public technical reports (competitor cells), '1' = official full-set scores, double-dagger = subtitles included for evaluation, WorldTravel = best of five attempts. The unnamed in-house 'Economically Valuable Fields' scenario panel (Education / Customer Support Q&A / Information Processing / Intention Recognition / Information Extraction / Complex Workflow, Image 8) has no benchmark name and is intentionally not converted into evidence rows. Blog points to the Model Card at seed.bytedance.com/seed1_8 for complete results.
